description: Stereo compressor for the C1 channel strip, with four detector models, parallel mixing, an external key input and gain reduction metering

params.text: Passes the input through with only the menu's output gain applied and takes the compressor out of circuit; the lamp beside it is lit while that is on
Steps the attack through six fixed times: 0.1ms, 0.3ms, 1ms, 3ms, 10ms and 30ms
Sets the recovery time, 100ms at the bottom rising to about 1170ms; the tooltip reads AUTO over the top tenth of the travel, but automatic release is never engaged there
Sets the level above which gain reduction starts, -20dB to +10dB, measured against 5V as 0dB or 10V if the menu is set that way
Sets how hard the signal is held down above the threshold, 1:1 at the bottom to 20:1 at the top, on a squared taper that puts 4:1 near the middle
Mixes the compressed signal against the untouched one, 0% for none of the compressor and 100% for all of it

inputs.text: The left input, and the source for the right channel as well while the right input is unpatched
The right input; with nothing patched here the left input feeds this channel too
Patching anything here makes it the signal the detector measures, rectified, for both channels, in place of the audio being compressed; the audio itself is unaffected by what this jack carries

outputs.text: The left channel after the compressor, the parallel mix and the menu's output gain
The right channel after the compressor, the parallel mix and the menu's output gain

notes: The row of red lamps under the display shows gain reduction, 2dB per lamp, none at the right and 20dB or more at the left.
The four small squares above the display choose the detector model, in the same order as the menu's Compressor Type list.
The small square at the top right of the display turns the meters off.
Each jack carries one channel, so a polyphonic cable is reduced to its first channel.
COM-X adds voltage control of the ratio, threshold, release and dry/wet mix, and has to be placed immediately to the right of this module.
Automatic release cannot be reached. The RELEASE knob is clamped to 89% of its travel before the test for the AUTO zone at 90%, so the tooltip promises a mode the module never enters.
menu: Auto Makeup Gain — adds makeup equal to half the threshold turned positive, so a -20dB threshold adds 10dB; it is off when the module is added
Input — a slider trimming the level going into the detector and the compressor, -24dB to +24dB
Output — a slider trimming the level leaving the module, -24dB to +24dB, and it applies in bypass as well
Knee — a slider setting the width of the knee, 0dB to 12dB, and printed as Auto at the bottom, which hands the choice to the chosen detector model
Compressor Type: VCA (SSL G), FET (1176), Optical (LA-2A), Vari-Mu (Fairchild) — chooses the detector and gain law
Input Reference Level: 0dBFS = 5V, 0dBFS = 10V — sets the voltage taken as full scale, which shifts what the THRESHOLD knob's dB numbers mean
VU Meter Mode: Dot Mode, Bar Mode — chooses whether the row of red lamps under the display shows one lamp or fills from the right

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the jack being compressed.
